# Shortpixel

ShortPixel is an image optimization and compression service that offers APIs and plugins to enhance website performance by reducing image sizes without compromising quality.

Category: Design. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/shortpixel/.

## Actions

- **Bulk Purge ShortPixel Storage**: Purge all files stored on shortpixel storage servers for a domain.
- **Get API Status** (read-only): Retrieve the current status of your api key, including available credits.
